# consensus

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/app/consensus"
```

Package consensus is the public facade of the SDK's consensus domain (ADR 0152): agreement of several machines on the order of their writes. A write is committed when a majority holds it on disk.

```
id, inc, _ := consensus.Init(dir, cluster, "fra")      // offline, every founder
_ = consensus.Bootstrap(ctx, &cfg, members)             // offline, identical list
node, _ := consensus.NewNode(cfg)                       // never bootstraps
tok, result, err := node.Propose(ctx, command)
```

### After OUTCOME\_UNKNOWN, never retry blindly

NOT\_LEADER means the proposal was certainly NOT appended and is safe to retry. OUTCOME\_UNKNOWN means it was appended, or possibly delivered, and the answer was lost: it may still commit. Read the state through Barrier and decide, or carry a per-key revision in the command, because a replayed compare-and-swap is not harmless under ABA (D6, R1-04).

### Reads

Barrier returns once the local state machine reflects every write committed before the call: ReadIndex by default, confirmed by a heartbeat round started after the read arrived. ReadLease is opt-in and sound only under the four conditions of D9; a leader paused after its lease check serves a stale read, which ReadIndex never does.

### Apply is a pure transition

StateMachine.Apply is called for every committed command, in log order, on one goroutine, and must be deterministic. An Apply that cannot complete must panic: the node stops with STATE\_MACHINE\_FAILED, and the entry IS committed.

<a name="Bootstrap"></a>
## func [Bootstrap](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/app/consensus/gen_facade.go>)

```go
func Bootstrap(ctx context.Context, cfg *Config, members []MemberValue) error
```

Bootstrap founds a cluster on one founding node, with the IDENTICAL member list on every founder. Idempotent and resumable. Its InitialTiming is completed and refused as NewNode's is, and rules every node once founded.


```go
func ImportObserved(d DataDir, p *ImportParams, newCluster ClusterID, members []MemberValue, opt *RestoreOptions) (SnapshotMetaValue, error)
```

<a name="Recover"></a>
## func [Recover](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/app/consensus/gen_facade.go>)

```go
func Recover(d DataDir, newCluster ClusterID, members []MemberValue, opt *RecoverOptions) error
```

Recover starts a new history from this node's committed log and the contiguous entries past it whose body and chain checksums verify and whose term does not decrease, every old voter left out attested fenced by every witness. An interrupted Recover leaves the stop marker STOP-RECOVER, which refuses a start until Recover runs again to the same new cluster. It removes the silence condition TruncateAndStaySilent left, and first finishes an install a crash interrupted after its snapshot was published, so the forced entry follows that snapshot.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/app/consensus/gen_facade.go>)

Every type needed to implement a published port is aliased here (R2-32).

```go
type Config = svcconsensus.Config
```

Config is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/service/app/consensus.Config`, declared as:

```go
type Config struct {
	// Cluster is the cluster the node belongs to; it must match the stamp.
	Cluster             coreconsensus.ClusterID
	// Group is the consensus group, 1 in v1; 0 is clamped to 1.
	Group               coreconsensus.GroupID
	// ID is the node; 0 takes the stamp's, any other value must match it.
	ID                  coreconsensus.NodeID
	// Machine is the replicated program.
	Machine             coreconsensus.StateMachine
	// Durability must agree with Machine's siblings.
	Durability          Durability
	// Log, Snapshots and Transport are the node's ports; the caller owns
	// them and closes them after the node.
	Log                 coreconsensus.LogStore
	Snapshots           coreconsensus.SnapshotStore
	Transport           coreconsensus.Transport
	// Clock drives every timer; nil is clock.System.
	Clock               clock.Timed
	// InitialTiming is proposed at Bootstrap only; the committed contract
	// rules.
	InitialTiming       coreconsensus.TimingContractSpec
	MaxBatchBytes       int
	MaxInflight         int
	MaxInflightBytes    int
	MaxEntryBytes       int
	MaxPendingBytes     int64
	MaxApplyLagBytes    int64
	RecentEntriesBytes  int64
	SnapshotEvery       uint64
	SnapshotTrailing    uint64
	PromoteLag          uint64
	SnapshotEveryBytes  int64
	MaxSnapshotBytes    int64
	MaxLogBytes         int64
	LogReserveBytes     int64
	// SnapshotCodec compresses snapshot chunks; nil is flate.
	SnapshotCodec       coretransform.BoundedDecompressor
	// SnapshotPausesApply says the state machine cannot cut cheaply.
	SnapshotPausesApply bool
	// MinVoters is the floor a Remove may not cross.
	MinVoters           int
	// JoinAuthorizer decides a JOIN; without it every JOIN is refused.
	JoinAuthorizer      coreconsensus.JoinAuthorizer
	// HardCloseTimeout bounds HardClose.
	HardCloseTimeout    time.Duration
	// Reads selects the read mode.
	Reads               ReadMode
	// PreferredLeaders are the nodes a leader transfers to after an
	// election when it is not one of them.
	PreferredLeaders    []coreconsensus.NodeID
	// Seed draws the election timeouts; 0 draws one.
	Seed                uint64
	// Meter, Tracer and Logger receive D13's metrics, one span per Propose
	// and the role, membership, snapshot and truncation events; nil turns
	// each off. None of them changes a decision.
	Meter               coremetrics.Meter
	Tracer              coretrace.Tracer
	Logger              corelogger.Logger
}
```

```go
	// code path that applies the entry.

	// BodySum is the CRC-32C of Data, computed by the proposer.
	BodySum  uint32
	// ChainSum chains the previous entry's header: computed by the LEADER at
	// its serialized append point, verified at append and before Apply.
	ChainSum uint32
	// Data is the payload: a command for EntryCommand, the engine's encoding
	// for the other kinds.
	Data     []byte

}
```

```go
	FailureTolerance   int
	// ApplyLagEntries is commit minus applied.
	ApplyLagEntries    uint64
	// Peers is the leader's view of every peer, nil elsewhere.
	Peers              []PeerHealthValue
	// ChainRefusals counts identical chain refusals of this follower at
	// ChainRefusalIndex from ChainRefusalLeader; the node reports itself
	// unready while it refuses (D4, R6-05).
	ChainRefusals      int
	ChainRefusalIndex  uint64
	ChainRefusalLeader coreconsensus.NodeID
	// StopReason says why the node stopped itself.
	StopReason         coreconsensus.StopReasonValue
	// DroppedFrames counts frames whose From differed from the
	// authenticated peer (R7-05).
	DroppedFrames      int64
	// LongTurns counts the loop turns longer than the drift budget, each of
	// which dropped the lease (D9, R7-20).
	LongTurns          int64
	// JoinsRateLimited counts JOINs refused by the one-per-slot rate.
	JoinsRateLimited   int64
	// SnapshotBytes is the size of the newest snapshot this node holds,
	// the larger of its encoded and decoded sizes; 0 with none.
	SnapshotBytes      int64
	// SnapshotLimit is the size a cut is held to now: this node's
	// MaxSnapshotBytes, or the smallest a member announces when lower
	// (R2-30).
	SnapshotLimit      int64
}
```

## type [LogIdentityValue](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/app/consensus/gen_facade.go>)

LogIdentityValue is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/core/app/consensus.LogIdentityValue`, declared as:

```go
type LogIdentityValue struct {
	// Cluster is the cluster the log belongs to.
	Cluster          ClusterID
	// Epoch counts the histories of this cluster id: 1 at founding.
	Epoch            uint64
	// Predecessor is the cluster of the history this one was recovered from,
	// zero for a founding.
	Predecessor      ClusterID
	// PredecessorEpoch is the predecessor's epoch.
	PredecessorEpoch uint64
	// KeptIndex is the last index Recover kept from the predecessor. An
	// applied position of the predecessor at or below it is still trusted
	// when its term is the one kept there: Recover adopts the verified
	// suffix past the commit the survivor persisted, which may hold
	// another term than the write the old cluster acknowledged.
	// Every node of the history applies the entries at or below it under the
	// predecessor's token: one admitted after the Recover learns it from the
	// snapshot it installs, never from an append.
	KeptIndex        uint64
	// AdoptedFrom is the last index of the kept range the predecessor had
	// committed when Recover read it: the commit the survivor persisted,
	// or the snapshot a restore started from. An entry at or below it is
	// the one every node of the predecessor holds (Log Matching), so a
	// predecessor's token at or below it is trusted by its index once its
	// term can no longer be read; the adopted range above it, up to
	// KeptIndex, is not. 0 records nothing, and nothing is trusted that
	// way. It is recorded only in a cluster at protocol version 2, in the
	// stamp of the node Recover or RestoreSnapshot ran on: a snapshot does
	// not carry it, so a node that learns the lineage from one trusts
	// nothing that way (#509).
	AdoptedFrom      uint64
}
```

```go
}
```

<a name="MessageValue"></a>
## type [MessageValue](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/app/consensus/gen_facade.go>)

Every type needed to implement a published port is aliased here (R2-32).

```go
type MessageValue = coreconsensus.MessageValue
```

MessageValue is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/core/app/consensus.MessageValue`, declared as:

```go
type MessageValue struct {
	// Version is the frame layout version, 1.
	Version        uint8
	// Group is the consensus group, 1 in v1.
	Group          GroupID
	// Kind says what the message is.
	Kind           MessageKind
	// Flags qualify it.
	Flags          MessageFlags
	// From is the sender, as the sender wrote it.
	From           NodeID
	// To is the receiver.
	To             NodeID
	// Term is the sender's term.
	Term           uint64
	// LogTerm is the term of the entry at Index: the previous entry of an
	// append, the last entry of a vote request.
	LogTerm        uint64
	// Index is the previous index of an append, the last index of a vote
	// request, the verified prefix of an acknowledgement, a read index.
	Index          uint64
	// Commit is the commit index the sender lets the receiver advance to.
	Commit         uint64
	// Reject marks a refusal.
	Reject         bool
	// RejectHint is the receiver's last index, a hint where to probe from.
	RejectHint     uint64
	// Context correlates a reply with its request: a heartbeat round, a read
	// request, a submission sequence.
	Context        uint64
	// TransferIssuer is the leader that issued a transfer flag.
	TransferIssuer NodeID
	// TransferTerm is the term the transfer flag was issued in.
	TransferTerm   uint64
	// Contract is the committed contract generation the sender has applied.
	Contract       uint64
	// Code is a refusal's error code, 0 for none.
	Code           errs.Code
	// Entries are the entries an append carries, or the proposal a forward
	// carries with a zero position.
	Entries        []EntryValue
}
```

### func \(Node\) [Close](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/app/consensus/node.go>)

```go
func (*Node) Close(ctx context.Context) error
```

Close transfers leadership first, then stops every goroutine after the storage actor's final sync (R2-38). It is idempotent.

<a name="Node.DenyPin"></a>
### func \(Node\) [DenyPin](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/app/consensus/ops.go>)

```go
func (*Node) DenyPin(ctx context.Context, op coreconsensus.Operator, id coreconsensus.NodeID) error
```

DenyPin withdraws a member's SPKI pin (R9-18). The transport refuses the member once the change commits. It is refused MEMBERSHIP\_INVALID for the leader itself, and while the voters that answer the leader, the target left out, are not a majority (R2-27).

<a name="Node.HardClose"></a>
### func \(Node\) [HardClose](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/app/consensus/node.go>)

```go
func (*Node) HardClose() error
```

HardClose stops now: no transfer, no final sync, bounded by HardCloseTimeout (R7-11). It launches one goroutine that waits for the node's goroutines; when the timeout fires first, that waiter is abandoned with them and the data directory stays held until the process exits.

<a name="Node.Propose"></a>
### func \(Node\) [Propose](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/app/consensus/ops.go>)

```go
func (*Node) Propose(ctx context.Context, data []byte) (coreconsensus.TokenValue, any, error)
```

Propose replicates data and returns, once the entry is applied locally, its token and the value Apply returned. NOT\_LEADER means certainly not appended; OUTCOME\_UNKNOWN means it may still commit: read the state through Barrier before deciding, never retry blindly (D6, R1-04).


```go
func (*Node) RaiseClusterVersion(ctx context.Context, op coreconsensus.Operator, pre coreconsensus.PreconditionSpec, v uint32) error
```

RaiseClusterVersion raises the protocol version every member must speak.

<a name="Node.ReadCommitted"></a>
### func \(Node\) [ReadCommitted](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/app/consensus/observed.go>)

```go
func (*Node) ReadCommitted(ctx context.Context, from uint64, to uint64, maxBytes int) ([]coreconsensus.EntryValue, error)
```

ReadCommitted returns the committed entries \[from, to], to clamped to what this node's log store holds as committed (its own commit, or the last entry applied from it), never to the commit the event loop knows of alone, at most maxBytes of them but always one when any is due. from below the first entry the log keeps is COMPACTED: the reader starts again from a snapshot. It reads the log store concurrently with the writer, as every reader does, and never waits on the loop.


Remove removes a member and retires its id; removing the leader first transfers leadership (D8).

```go

```

TransferLeadership moves leadership to a voter (D8). It records the operator in an entry, then waits until the target leads or twice the maximum election timeout passes.

<a name="Node.UpdateAddress"></a>
### func \(Node\) [UpdateAddress](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/app/consensus/ops.go>)

```go

```

<a name="Node.WaitApplied"></a>
### func \(Node\) [WaitApplied](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/app/consensus/ops.go>)

```go
func (*Node) WaitApplied(ctx context.Context, t coreconsensus.TokenValue) error
```

WaitApplied returns once the local node has applied t, the entry of t's term at t's index. A token of another lineage is LINEAGE\_MISMATCH. A token whose index holds an entry of another term is ENTRY\_SUPERSEDED, carrying the token of the entry applied there, or LINEAGE\_MISMATCH when it is one of the predecessor's within the index Recover kept, as is a token of the predecessor's whose term this node can no longer read there.


Watch implements LeadershipWatcher. Each call launches one goroutine that closes the returned channel and ends when ctx ends or the node's event loop stops.

```go
type Replicated interface {
	// Barrier returns once the local state machine reflects every write
	// committed before the call, with the token of the applied index.
	Barrier(ctx context.Context) (TokenValue, error)
	// Propose replicates data and returns, once the entry is applied
	// locally, its lineage-scoped token and the value Apply returned.
	// NOT_LEADER means certainly not appended; OUTCOME_UNKNOWN means it may
	// still commit, and the caller must read the state before deciding.
	Propose(ctx context.Context, data []byte) (TokenValue, any, error)
	// Status returns the node's view after its last turn.
	Status() StatusValue
	// WaitApplied returns once the local node has applied t, the entry of
	// t's term at t's index. A token of another lineage is
	// LINEAGE_MISMATCH. A token whose index holds an entry of another term
	// is ENTRY_SUPERSEDED, or LINEAGE_MISMATCH when it is one of the
	// predecessor's within the index Recover kept, as is a token of the
	// predecessor's whose term the node can no longer read there.
	WaitApplied(ctx context.Context, t TokenValue) error
}
```

```go
type SnapshotMetaValue struct {
	// ID names the snapshot, the same in a spool, an offer and a handle.
	ID                string
	// Version is the snapshot format version, 1.
	Version           uint8
	// Position is the last entry the snapshot covers.

	// Log is the identity of the log the snapshot was cut from.
	Log               LogIdentityValue
	// Membership is the configuration valid at Position, never a later one.
	Membership        MembershipValue
	// ChainTip is the authenticated chain value at Position: the chain is
	// carried across the boundary, never reseeded.
	ChainTip          uint32
	// Codec names the compression of the chunks: "flate" or "gzip".
	Codec             string
	// EncodedSize is the size of the encoded stream, chunk headers included.
	EncodedSize       int64
	// DecodedSize is the size of the decoded stream.
	DecodedSize       int64
	// ChunkSize is the largest decoded chunk.
	ChunkSize         int64
	// SHA256 is the digest of the DECODED stream, computed by the engine.
	SHA256            [32]byte
	// Timing is the committed timing contract at Position.
	Timing            TimingContractSpec
	// ClusterVersion is the committed cluster version at Position.
	ClusterVersion    uint32
	// ClusterGeneration counts its raises.
	ClusterGeneration uint64
	// NoSpace is the no-space alarm raised at Position, 0 for none.
	NoSpace           AlarmID
	// Reserved is carried uninterpreted for ADR 0173.
	Reserved          []byte
}
```

```go
type StateMachine interface {
	// Apply applies one committed command and returns its result, delivered
	// to the Propose that created it on the node that created it.
	Apply(e EntryValue) any
	// Restore replaces the state with a snapshot's. It is serialised with
	// Apply. An error coded VERSION_UNSUPPORTED says the snapshot is of a
	// format this build does not read: the node stops, as for an entry
	// kind it does not know, and a restart over that snapshot is refused
	// (D18). Any other error refuses that one install, and the leader
	// offers a snapshot again.
	Restore(r io.Reader, meta SnapshotMetaValue) error
	// Snapshot captures a point-in-time view of the state, cheaply: it is
	// called on the apply goroutine.
	Snapshot() (Snapshot, error)
}
```

```go
type Transport interface {
	// Bind registers the group's callbacks. deliver gets the frame and the
	// peer TLS authenticated, valid until deliver returns; offer is answered
	// on the event loop; join is answered off it, under a deadline.
	Bind(group GroupID, deliver func(from AuthenticatedPeerValue, frame []byte), offer func(from AuthenticatedPeerValue, o InstallOfferValue) InstallAcceptValue, install func(InstallParams) error, join func(ctx context.Context, from AuthenticatedPeerValue, r JoinRequestValue) (PositionValue, errs.Code)) error
	// Send hands over an encoded frame. It never blocks and may drop; the
	// transport owns frame after the call.
	Send(to NodeID, frame []byte)
	// SetMembership pushes the group's admitted members; the transport
	// computes the union over its groups.
	SetMembership(group GroupID, admitted []MemberValue)
	// Stream sends a snapshot from the offset the receiver accepted; open
	// returns a reader at an encoded offset on a chunk boundary, which
	// Stream closes.
	Stream(ctx context.Context, to NodeID, offer InstallOfferValue, open func(offset int64) (io.ReadCloser, error)) error
}
```

```go
type TransportConfig struct {
	// Certificate is the node's certificate and key. It carries exactly one
	// URI SAN, kitsunium-consensus://<cluster>/slot/<slot>, and both
	// serverAuth and clientAuth; the transport takes its cluster and slot
	// from it. GetCertificate, when set, is asked at every handshake instead,
	// so a renewed certificate over the same key is picked up in place.
	Certificate             *tls.Certificate
	GetCertificate          func() (*tls.Certificate, error)
	// Roots is the consensus intermediate, trusted as RootCAs and ClientCAs.
	Roots                   *x509.CertPool
	// ListenAddress is bound as given, e.g. a private interface (R2-37).
	ListenAddress           string
	// Seeds are addresses for the first contact; the committed membership's
	// addresses rule afterwards.
	Seeds                   map[coreconsensus.NodeID]string
	// MaxUnauthenticatedPerIP caps the connections an IPv4 address, or an
	// IPv6 /64, may hold before their handshake completes; the addresses
	// the admitted members' addresses resolve to get ReservedMemberSlots
	// instead, so a flood never locks a member out (R2-22). It runs before
	// any TLS byte is read.
	MaxUnauthenticatedPerIP int
	ReservedMemberSlots     int
	MaxFrameBytes           int
	MaxControlFrameBytes    int
	HandshakeTimeout        time.Duration
	PeerQueueBytes          int64
	MaxConnectionAge        time.Duration
	WriteTimeout            time.Duration
	JoinTimeout             time.Duration
}
```
